#### HDL & Code Specifications

##### Proficiency

- [ ] Top level consists only of instantiated modules and trivial logic.
- [ ] One module per file with a descriptive name, filename matches module name (e.g., `lab2_jb.sv` contains module `lab2_jb`)
- [ ] Descriptive variable names
- [ ] Neat formatting (e.g., standard indentation, consistent formatting for variable names (kebab-case/snake_case/camelCase/PascalCase ))

##### Excellence

- [ ] External (i.e.: not in the comments) documentation for module captures major features, describing each in text and supporting with waveforms if necessary. Special attention paid to whether modules are combinational or sequential, and whether sequential behaviors are synchronous or asynchronous.
- [ ] Clear and organized hierarchy (e.g., delineation between top level modules and submodules)
